---
title: "Pre-Flight Quality Check for Airborne LiDAR Data"
author: "Dingjin Chu"
date: "2026-02-01"
categories: [LiDAR Preprocess]
description: "Before any processing, run these checks across lidR, lasR, and Python — CRS consistency, point density, Z-range sanity, return structure, and classification summary. Catches catalog-level problems in seconds from headers alone."
---

Airborne LiDAR tiles from 3DEP, NEON AOP, or proprietary vendors are rarely uniformly clean across a catalog. Before committing to any processing pipeline, a quick pre-flight check catches CRS mismatches, density gaps, bogus Z values, missing ground classification, and all-single-return anomalies — all from file headers alone, without loading a single point.

This post is the QC step that precedes the [pre-processing pipeline](../lidar-preprocessing/index.qmd).

---

### 0.1 CRS Validation

::: {.panel-tabset}

## lidR

```r
library(lidR)
library(sf)

ctg <- readLAScatalog("path/to/las_folder/")

# Extract CRS from every tile header (fast — reads only the header, not points)
crs_list <- lapply(ctg@data$filename, function(f) st_crs(readLASheader(f))$wkt)
n_unique  <- length(unique(crs_list))

if (n_unique > 1) {
  warning(sprintf("CRS MISMATCH: %d different CRS found across %d tiles!",
                  n_unique, length(crs_list)))
} else {
  message("CRS OK — all tiles: ", st_crs(ctg)$input)
}
```

## lasR

```r
# lasR has no header-scan stage; CRS inspection is done via lidR
# readLASheader() before building the pipeline.
library(lidR)
library(lasR)
library(sf)

headers   <- lapply(list.files("path/to/las_folder/", pattern="\\.la[sz]$",
                               full.names=TRUE), readLASheader)
crs_wkts  <- sapply(headers, function(h) st_crs(h)$wkt)
n_unique  <- length(unique(crs_wkts))

if (n_unique > 1) warning("CRS MISMATCH: ", n_unique, " different projections found.")
else message("CRS OK: ", st_crs(headers[[1]])$input)
```

## Python

```python
import laspy, glob
from pyproj import CRS

files = sorted(glob.glob("path/to/las_folder/*.laz"))

def get_crs(filepath):
    with laspy.open(filepath) as f:
        try:
            return f.header.parse_crs().to_wkt()
        except Exception:
            return "unknown"

crs_list = [get_crs(f) for f in files]
unique_crs = set(crs_list)

if len(unique_crs) > 1:
    print(f"CRS MISMATCH: {len(unique_crs)} different projections across {len(files)} tiles!")
    for f, c in zip(files, crs_list):
        name = CRS.from_wkt(c).name if c != "unknown" else "unknown"
        print(f"  {f}: {name}")
else:
    crs = CRS.from_wkt(crs_list[0]) if crs_list[0] != "unknown" else None
    print(f"CRS OK — all tiles: {crs.name if crs else 'unknown'}")
```

:::

### 0.2 Point Density

::: {.panel-tabset}

## lidR

```r
# LAScatalog stores per-tile header stats (no points loaded)
dens_tbl <- ctg@data
dens_tbl$area    <- (dens_tbl$Max.X - dens_tbl$Min.X) *
                    (dens_tbl$Max.Y - dens_tbl$Min.Y)
dens_tbl$density <- dens_tbl$Number.of.point.records / dens_tbl$area

cat(sprintf(
  "Density summary (pts/m²):\n  min=%.1f  median=%.1f  max=%.1f\n",
  min(dens_tbl$density), median(dens_tbl$density), max(dens_tbl$density)
))

# Flag tiles below a minimum acceptable density
low_dens <- dens_tbl[dens_tbl$density < 2, c("filename", "density")]
if (nrow(low_dens) > 0) {
  warning(nrow(low_dens), " tile(s) below 2 pts/m²:")
  print(low_dens)
}

# Visualise density map
plot(ctg, attribute = "density")
```

## lasR

```r
# Header-based density (same as lidR approach — no pipeline needed)
library(lidR)

headers <- lapply(list.files("path/to/las_folder/", pattern="\\.la[sz]$",
                             full.names=TRUE), readLASheader)

dens <- sapply(headers, function(h) {
  pts  <- h@PHB[["Number of point records"]]
  area <- (h@PHB[["Max X"]] - h@PHB[["Min X"]]) *
          (h@PHB[["Max Y"]] - h@PHB[["Min Y"]])
  pts / area
})

cat(sprintf("Density: min=%.1f  median=%.1f  max=%.1f pts/m²\n",
            min(dens), median(dens), max(dens)))

# lasR alternative: stream a point-count raster at 10 m resolution
library(lasR)
pipeline <- reader_las() +
            rasterize(10, ~list(n = length(Z)), ofile = "density_10m.tif")
exec(pipeline, on = "path/to/las_folder/", ncores = 4L)
```

## Python

```python
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

def tile_density(filepath):
    with laspy.open(filepath) as f:
        hdr = f.header
        pts = hdr.point_count
        dx  = hdr.x_max - hdr.x_min
        dy  = hdr.y_max - hdr.y_min
        area = dx * dy
    return {"file": Path(filepath).name,
            "n_pts": pts,
            "density": pts / area if area > 0 else 0,
            "area_m2": area}

records   = [tile_density(f) for f in files]
densities = np.array([r["density"] for r in records])

print(f"Density (pts/m²): min={densities.min():.1f}  "
      f"median={np.median(densities):.1f}  max={densities.max():.1f}")

low = [r for r in records if r["density"] < 2]
if low:
    print(f"\n{len(low)} tile(s) below 2 pts/m²:")
    for r in low:
        print(f"  {r['file']}: {r['density']:.2f} pts/m²")
```

:::

---

### 0.3 Z-Range / Elevation Sanity

::: {.panel-tabset}

## lidR

```r
z_range_tbl <- ctg@data[, c("filename", "Min.Z", "Max.Z")]
z_range_tbl$span <- z_range_tbl$Max.Z - z_range_tbl$Min.Z

bad_z <- z_range_tbl[
  z_range_tbl$Min.Z < -100 |
  z_range_tbl$Max.Z > 5000 |
  z_range_tbl$span  < 0.5,
]
if (nrow(bad_z) > 0) {
  warning(nrow(bad_z), " tile(s) with suspicious Z range:")
  print(bad_z)
}

cat(sprintf("Z range across catalog: %.1f m — %.1f m\n",
            min(ctg@data$Min.Z), max(ctg@data$Max.Z)))
```

## lasR

```r
z_mins <- sapply(headers, function(h) h@PHB[["Min Z"]])
z_maxs <- sapply(headers, function(h) h@PHB[["Max Z"]])

cat(sprintf("Z range: %.1f m — %.1f m\n", min(z_mins), max(z_maxs)))

bad <- which(z_mins < -100 | z_maxs > 5000 | (z_maxs - z_mins) < 0.5)
if (length(bad) > 0) {
  warning(length(bad), " tile(s) with suspicious Z range")
  for (i in bad)
    cat(sprintf("  %s: Z [%.1f, %.1f]\n",
                basename(files[i]), z_mins[i], z_maxs[i]))
}
```

## Python

```python
def tile_z_range(filepath):
    with laspy.open(filepath) as f:
        hdr = f.header
    return {"file":   Path(filepath).name,
            "z_min":  hdr.z_min,
            "z_max":  hdr.z_max,
            "z_span": hdr.z_max - hdr.z_min}

z_records = [tile_z_range(f) for f in files]

print(f"Z range across catalog: "
      f"{min(r['z_min'] for r in z_records):.1f} m — "
      f"{max(r['z_max'] for r in z_records):.1f} m")

bad_z = [r for r in z_records
         if r["z_min"] < -100 or r["z_max"] > 5000 or r["z_span"] < 0.5]
if bad_z:
    print(f"\n{len(bad_z)} tile(s) with suspicious Z range:")
    for r in bad_z:
        print(f"  {r['file']}: [{r['z_min']:.1f}, {r['z_max']:.1f}] m "
              f"span={r['z_span']:.1f} m")
```

:::

| Flag | Threshold | Meaning |
|------|-----------|---------|
| Min.Z too low | < −100 m | Likely corrupt or wrong vertical datum |
| Max.Z too high | > 5000 m | Sensor artifact or wrong scale factor |
| Z span too small | < 0.5 m | Flat file — all ground, rasterized, or empty |

### 0.4 Return Structure

::: {.panel-tabset}

## lidR

```r
return_qc <- function(las) {
  rn   <- las$ReturnNumber
  nr   <- las$NumberOfReturns
  list(
    n_total        = length(rn),
    pct_single     = mean(nr == 1) * 100,
    pct_first      = mean(rn == 1) * 100,
    pct_last       = mean(rn == nr) * 100,
    max_return_num = max(rn),
    has_multi      = any(nr > 1)
  )
}

las_s <- readLAS(ctg@data$filename[1])
rq    <- return_qc(las_s)
print(rq)

if (!rq$has_multi)
  warning("No multi-return pulses — data may be from a rasterised (gridded) source.")
```

## lasR

```r
pipeline <-
  reader_las() +
  rasterize(
    res     = 500,
    metrics = ~list(
      pct_single = mean(NumberOfReturns == 1) * 100,
      max_rn     = max(ReturnNumber),
      has_multi  = as.integer(any(NumberOfReturns > 1))
    ),
    ofile = "return_qc.tif"
  )
exec(pipeline, on = "path/to/las_folder/", ncores = 4L)
```

## Python

```python
def return_qc(filepath):
    las = laspy.read(filepath)
    rn  = np.array(las.return_number)
    nr  = np.array(las.number_of_returns)
    return {
        "file":           Path(filepath).name,
        "n_points":       len(rn),
        "pct_single":     np.mean(nr == 1) * 100,
        "pct_first":      np.mean(rn == 1) * 100,
        "max_return_num": int(rn.max()),
        "has_multi":      bool(np.any(nr > 1))
    }

for f in files[:5]:
    rq   = return_qc(f)
    flag = " ⚠ ALL-SINGLE-RETURN" if not rq["has_multi"] else ""
    print(f"{rq['file']}: {rq['pct_single']:.1f}% single-return, "
          f"max RN={rq['max_return_num']}{flag}")
```

:::

::: {.callout-warning}
All-single-return datasets are not suitable for canopy penetration metrics, gap fraction, or multi-return structural indices. Verify with the data provider before proceeding.
:::

### 0.5 Classification Summary

::: {.panel-tabset}

## lidR

```r
class_qc <- function(las) {
  cls  <- las$Classification
  tbl  <- table(cls)
  prop <- round(prop.table(tbl) * 100, 1)
  data.frame(
    class = as.integer(names(tbl)),
    label = LASCLASSIFICATION[as.integer(names(tbl)) + 1],
    n_pts = as.integer(tbl),
    pct   = as.numeric(prop)
  )
}

las_s   <- readLAS(ctg@data$filename[1])
cls_tbl <- class_qc(las_s)
print(cls_tbl)

has_ground <- any(las_s$Classification == LASGROUND)
has_noise  <- any(las_s$Classification %in% c(7L, 18L))
cat("Ground classified:", has_ground, "\nNoise flagged:", has_noise, "\n")
```

## lasR

```r
pipeline <-
  reader_las() +
  rasterize(
    res     = 500,
    metrics = ~list(
      pct_ground   = mean(Classification == 2L)         * 100,
      pct_veg      = mean(Classification %in% c(3L,4L,5L)) * 100,
      pct_building = mean(Classification == 6L)         * 100,
      pct_noise    = mean(Classification %in% c(7L,18L)) * 100,
      pct_unclass  = mean(Classification == 1L)         * 100,
      has_ground   = as.integer(any(Classification == 2L))
    ),
    ofile = "classification_qc.tif"
  )
exec(pipeline, on = "path/to/las_folder/", ncores = 4L)
```

## Python

```python
CLASS_LABELS = {
    0: "Never classified", 1: "Unclassified",     2: "Ground",
    3: "Low vegetation",   4: "Medium vegetation", 5: "High vegetation",
    6: "Building",         7: "Low point (noise)", 9: "Water",
    17: "Bridge deck",     18: "High noise"
}

def class_qc(filepath):
    las = laspy.read(filepath)
    cls = np.array(las.classification)
    unique, counts = np.unique(cls, return_counts=True)
    total = len(cls)
    return [
        {"class": int(c),
         "label": CLASS_LABELS.get(int(c), f"Class {c}"),
         "n_pts": int(n),
         "pct":   round(n / total * 100, 1)}
        for c, n in zip(unique, counts)
    ]

for row in class_qc(files[0]):
    print(f"  Class {row['class']:2d} ({row['label']:20s}): "
          f"{row['n_pts']:>8,d}  ({row['pct']:5.1f}%)")
```

:::

| Class | Label | Pre-processing implication |
|-------|-------|---------------------------|
| 1 | Unclassified | Ground classification needed (Stage 2) |
| 2 | Ground | Already present — CSF can be skipped |
| 6 | Building | Urban dataset — building metrics available |
| 7 / 18 | Noise (low / high) | Remove before normalization |
| 9 | Water | Exclude from height normalization (flat surface) |

### 0.6 Complete QC Report

::: {.panel-tabset}

## lidR

```r
qc_catalog <- function(ctg) {
  d        <- ctg@data
  d$area   <- (d$Max.X - d$Min.X) * (d$Max.Y - d$Min.Y)
  d$density <- d$Number.of.point.records / d$area
  d$z_span  <- d$Max.Z - d$Min.Z

  flags <- data.frame(
    file           = basename(d$filename),
    density        = round(d$density, 1),
    z_min          = round(d$Min.Z, 1),
    z_max          = round(d$Max.Z, 1),
    z_span         = round(d$z_span, 1),
    flag_low_dens  = d$density < 2,
    flag_bad_z     = d$Min.Z < -100 | d$Max.Z > 5000 | d$z_span < 0.5
  )

  n_bad <- sum(flags$flag_low_dens | flags$flag_bad_z)
  cat(sprintf(
    "QC summary: %d tiles | density %.1f–%.1f pts/m² | Z %.1f–%.1f m | %d flag(s)\n",
    nrow(d), min(d$density), max(d$density),
    min(d$Min.Z), max(d$Max.Z), n_bad
  ))
  if (n_bad > 0) print(flags[flags$flag_low_dens | flags$flag_bad_z, ])
  invisible(flags)
}

flags <- qc_catalog(ctg)
```

## lasR

```r
library(lidR); library(lasR)

files   <- list.files("path/to/las_folder/", pattern="\\.la[sz]$", full.names=TRUE)
headers <- lapply(files, readLASheader)

qc_hdr <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(headers), function(i) {
  h    <- headers[[i]]
  pts  <- h@PHB[["Number of point records"]]
  dx   <- h@PHB[["Max X"]] - h@PHB[["Min X"]]
  dy   <- h@PHB[["Max Y"]] - h@PHB[["Min Y"]]
  data.frame(
    file     = basename(files[i]),
    density  = pts / (dx * dy),
    z_min    = h@PHB[["Min Z"]],
    z_max    = h@PHB[["Max Z"]],
    z_span   = h@PHB[["Max Z"]] - h@PHB[["Min Z"]]
  )
}))
print(summary(qc_hdr[, -1]))

# Stream a 10 m density raster for visual inspection
pipeline <- reader_las() +
            rasterize(10, ~list(n = length(Z)), ofile = "density_check_10m.tif")
exec(pipeline, on = "path/to/las_folder/", ncores = 4L)
```

## Python

```python
import pandas as pd

def full_qc(files, density_threshold=2.0, z_min_ok=-100, z_max_ok=5000):
    records = []
    for f in files:
        with laspy.open(f) as lf:
            hdr = lf.header
            pts = hdr.point_count
            dx  = hdr.x_max - hdr.x_min
            dy  = hdr.y_max - hdr.y_min
        area    = dx * dy
        density = pts / area if area > 0 else 0
        records.append({
            "file":          Path(f).name,
            "n_pts":         pts,
            "density":       round(density, 2),
            "z_min":         round(hdr.z_min, 1),
            "z_max":         round(hdr.z_max, 1),
            "z_span":        round(hdr.z_max - hdr.z_min, 1),
            "flag_low_dens": density < density_threshold,
            "flag_bad_z":    (hdr.z_min < z_min_ok or hdr.z_max > z_max_ok
                              or (hdr.z_max - hdr.z_min) < 0.5)
        })

    df      = pd.DataFrame(records)
    flagged = df[df["flag_low_dens"] | df["flag_bad_z"]]

    print(f"QC summary: {len(df)} tiles | "
          f"density {df['density'].min():.1f}–{df['density'].max():.1f} pts/m² | "
          f"Z {df['z_min'].min():.1f}–{df['z_max'].max():.1f} m | "
          f"{len(flagged)} flag(s)")
    if len(flagged) > 0:
        print("\nFlagged tiles:")
        print(flagged.to_string(index=False))
    return df

qc_df = full_qc(files)
```

:::

---

::: {.callout-tip}
**Recommended QC checklist before processing:**

- [ ] All tiles share one projected CRS (UTM or state plane — not geographic WGS84)
- [ ] Point density ≥ 2 pts/m² (prefer ≥ 5 for canopy metrics)
- [ ] Z range is plausible for the landscape (no −9999 nodata placeholders)
- [ ] Multi-return pulses present (at least some NumberOfReturns > 1)
- [ ] Class 2 (ground) present **or** ground classification planned
- [ ] Noise proportion (Classes 7/18) < ~1% of total returns
:::

---

::: {.callout-note}
Once the catalog passes QC, proceed to the [pre-processing pipeline](../lidar-preprocessing/index.qmd) for ground classification, height normalization, noise removal, and decimation.
:::
